messages:
vivian: Heads-upwe're seeing marketplace leads go straight to AEs and partners miss out. Need a lightweight SI handoff pattern: stamp + partner offer + claim window.

sam-prod: Proposal: when marketplace webhook fires, add tags: source=marketplace, si_candidate=true, arr_est, partner_hint. Fire partner_offer webhook with 24h claim TTL.

tereza-ops: 24h is fine for most. For ARR>200k make it expedited (4h) and notify both AE + partner. Also include hw_interest and nda_required flags.

devin-partner: Can partners accept from their portal? If we give them a single-click accept/decline it will reduce noise. When they accept, CRM owner becomes partner rep.

nora-sales: Also add an auto-decline fallback: if partner_decline or no ack within TTL, route to AE with partner_decline reason and analytics event.

marketplace-bot: New lead MP-13100 created: Org=BlueForge Labs, arr_est=275000, tags=[marketplace,si_candidate,hw_interest] 

vivian: Action items: Sam draft webhook payloads and TTL logic, Tereza add flags to intake schema, Devin confirm portal accept flow, Nora confirm AE fallback. Pilot with two partners next sprint.

sam-prod: Will post runbook + example payload. Example: {"lead_id":"MP-13100","org":"BlueForge Labs","arr_est":275000,"tags":["marketplace","si_candidate"],"hw_interest":true,"nda_required":false} 

devin-partner: I'm in for pilot. Will test portal ack + bandwidth flag.

tereza-ops: I'll instrument events: time_to_ack, ack_rate, fallback_rate. Revisit after 7 days.

vivian: Great. We'll keep the protocol intentionally simple to start. Thanks team.
